content: While Abhishek’s century was the headline act, Sooryavanshi’s fearless approach set the tone. The pair raced to a stunning 133-run stand in just seven overs, blowing New Zealand away. The Abhishek-Sooryavanshi partnership also offered a glimpse into the mindset of a new generation of T20 batters, one that sees every ball as a scoring opportunity.

title: Big setback for New Zealand! Star player ruled out of India T20I series

With India already leading 3-0, the team has summoned Matt Fisher to enhance their bowling strength. title: Amazon layoffs hit devices and services unit, email cites ‘review of our structure’

These layoffs follow recent product launches, including new Kindle e-readers and tablet computers. This decision aims to improve operational efficiency and align with the company’s product roadmap. Earlier this year, Amazon announced significant job reductions, further indicating structural changes within the organization.

title: IMD issues yellow alert for Delhi-NCR; rain, thunderstorms & hailstorms likely
content: A yellow alert has been issued for rain and thunderstorms in Delhi-NCR for Thursday and Friday. The IMD forecasts a generally cloudy sky with winds reaching 40-50 kmph during the morning. Light to moderate rainfall is expected along with possible hailstorms in the region. Residents are advised to remain cautious during thunderstorms and strong winds. The air quality in Delhi has also deteriorated to the poor category recently.

title: Four friends turned homemade cinnamon rolls into a $7m business on Target shelves
content: Sunshine Buns has successfully secured $7 million in Series A funding, allowing them to broaden their store presence. Founded by four friends using a family cinnamon roll recipe, their frozen delights are now featured in major retailers like Target and Costco. This new funding will support production and marketing efforts, and the founders attribute their success to local mentors and the nurturing startup community in Utah.

title: Oil prices slip as peace hopes ease supply fears, Middle East tensions limit losses
content: In a market shaken by geopolitical tensions, oil prices saw a downturn as traders considered possible U.S.-Iran diplomatic actions against the backdrop of supply disruption risks. Brent crude prices slipped by 0.74%, while WTI dropped by 0.89%. The recent assaults by Yemen's Houthis have further complicated the already uncertain market landscape. Mixed signals from U.S. inventory reports only added to the volatility affecting crude oil valuations.

title: 3 Wall Street firms agree to pay up to $100,000 a month to get Trump’s posts faster
content: Donald Trump's Truth API, a subscription-based social media service, is attracting a diverse clientele, including Bloomberg and various trading firms, by offering rapid access to his posts. This service's growing popularity raises ethical questions about the commercialization of presidential communication and its potential effects on market dynamics. Amid ongoing legal challenges and mounting criticism, Trump's media company faces heightened scrutiny due to its reduced market value and controversial business practices.

title: In setback to BJP, Congress wins Nagpur MLC seat
content: Abhijeet Wanjari from Congress has retained the Nagpur Division Graduates' constituency seat after a tight election. He defeated BJP's Sudhakar Kohale by 3,271 votes following over 40 hours of counting. Kohale initially led during the second round of counting but Wanjari eventually prevailed. The elections for Maharashtra legislative council were conducted for five constituencies, reflecting some differences within the ruling Mahayuti alliance.

title: Celine Dion's former Florida mansion sells for $12.5m after $20m listing
content: Celine Dion’s former Florida mansion in Jupiter has sold for $12.5 million in an off-market deal. Built for the singer in 1998, the waterfront property was sold by her for $9 million in 2002. The 14,750-square-foot luxury home features eight bedrooms, a private dock, a swimming pool and a lavish home theatre. It was listed for $20 million earlier this year.

title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's gift lets Nashville grocery store resume aid
content: Prior to their wedding at Madison Square Garden, Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donated $26 million to various charities. One of the notable beneficiaries was The Store, a Nashville non-profit aimed at combating food insecurity. Due to rising food costs, The Store had paused the admission of new families prior to receiving the donation. The couple's charitable efforts supported 20 local and national organizations, reflecting their deep community ties.

title: Zuckerberg & wife give California $50 mn weeks after donation shift announcement
content: In a significant move, Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan announced a generous $50 million contribution to Sacramento State University’s redevelopment. The funds will be directed towards building a new downtown campus with essential student housing and cutting-edge STEM resources. California Governor Gavin Newsom praised this gift's role in training future technology leaders and meeting housing demands.

title: Sacred 15,000-ft Uttarakhand Gurudwara needs 19-km Himalayan trek
content: Nestled in the breathtaking Garhwal Himalayas, Gurudwara Hemkund Sahib stands as a sacred destination for Sikh devotees. Perched at a height of 4,632 meters, it is encircled by seven majestic peaks and a serene glacial lake. Pilgrims undertake a challenging 19-kilometre trek to reach this holy site, which is currently enhancing accessibility with a new ropeway project.

title: Mystery surrounds deaths of Ayurveda hospital owner, son, daughter
content: Aarti Soni, along with her children Nilkanth and Jainy, was found dead in their home. The domestic worker's concern led to the discovery of the bodies hanging from a ceiling fan. Investigators suspect the deaths occurred several days prior due to a foul smell. Aarti had recently made plans to expand her family's Ayurveda hospital, which they managed after her husband's death.

title: 'From the river to the sea': Hundreds rally across Israel advocating Jewish-Arab gov

Protesters held signs advocating for freedom and inclusive governance, reflecting their unified call. The demonstrations coincided with ongoing vote counting following Israel's closely contested election. Pro-Netanyahu parties secured 53 seats, while the opposing bloc held 48, leaving no clear majority. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot emphasized a need for change, criticizing Netanyahu's government.

title: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany's KC Current to launch holiday light experience

Starting November 27, the five-weekend event will feature a 26-foot Christmas tree, teal light displays, a train depot and a larger-than-life Santa. Visitors can explore the festive attraction in about an hour, giving families a new holiday destination beyond the soccer season.

title: Gisele Bündchen reacts amid Tom Brady and Candice Swanepoel dating rumors

title: SC summons Sanjay Raut in contempt case
content:
File photo: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut

NEW DELHI: Supreme Court Wednesday directed Shiv Sena (UBT) Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Raut to appear before it in person over a contempt petition for his remarks against CJI Surya Kant and the judiciary. Although journalist Nikhil Wagle is also facing the same charge of scandalising the institution, he has been exempted from physical appearance and asked to be present virtually as he was represented by a lawyer in the court proceedings on Wednesday. A bench of Justices Aravind Kumar and Vipul M Pancholi said that the issue raised is very important as it pertains to the entire institution of the judiciary and sought assistance from lawyers. The contempt petition was filed by Supreme Court Bar Association and all its office-bearers present in court contended that their social media posts were based on fake news and had maligned the judiciary and judges, including CJI.

End of Article

title: NDA wins 16 of 28 seats, Congress falters in MLC polls
content: BJP-led NDA won 16 of 28 seats in MLC polls across four states . BJP led in UP as counting of paper ballots continued from Tuesday till late Wednesday . in karnataka, JD(S) wrested Bengaluru teachers, while BJP won North East teachers, West graduates and South East graduates .

title: From Brazil to Cuba, US turns up the heat

title: Delhi HC rejects PIL against passport fee hike for NRIs
content:
File photo: Indian passport

NEW DELHI: Delhi high court on Wednesday dismissed a PIL challenging the central govt’s decision to increase passport fees for non-resident Indians (NRIs), observing that a 67% hike after a gap of 14 years is not “unreasonable or exorbitant”. Acting chief justice Nitin Wasudeo Sambre and justice Sanjay Sharma added that the decision to determine the fees falls within the policy domain of the govt and judicial intervention was not warranted. Pravasi Legal Cell filed the petition, alleging discrimination against NRIs, who are required to pay around Rs 11,900 for passports, compared to Rs 2,500 for resident Indians.

title: 'There was mangled mess of metal': Eyewitnesses recount Spain train crash
content: "the train never braked, and I felt that with every millisecond that passed," one of the survivors says . the collision between two high-speed trains near Urda killed at least 68 people and left dozens injured . "all of Spain is in mourning," says prime minister Pedro Sánchez . witnesses describe scenes of terror and devastation after the two trains collide .
